h.A diferença entre um cliente que avalia: The difference between a customer who happily leaves a review and one who pretends not to hear isn't in what you ask — it's in how and when. This guide shows the most common mistakes and gives you ready-made scripts for three real situations.
h.Quase todo dono de negócio que tenta ped: Almost every business owner who tries to ask for reviews feels the same discomfort: it feels like demanding, like begging, like bothering people. And the truth is it feels annoying because it usually is annoying — but only because the request is made the wrong way.
h.Bem feito, pedir uma avaliação é complet: Done well, asking for a review is completely natural. Customers even appreciate the chance to help. The difference comes down to three things: timing, tone and friction. Let's go through all three.
h.Logo após um elogio espontâneo. Cliente: Right after spontaneous praise. The customer said "wow, this turned out great"? NOW is the time. That's gold.
h.No fechamento do atendimento, na despedi: At the end of the service, when saying goodbye. The person is leaving, satisfied, in a light mood. A short, kind request fits right in.
h.Logo após resolver um problema bem. Clie: Right after solving a problem well. The customer had a complaint, you handled it, they left happy — it's an even more powerful moment than regular service.
h.Regra de ouro: se o cliente está em esta: Golden rule: if the customer is in a positive mood and the interaction is over, it's time to ask. If the interaction isn't over yet, don't ask. If more than 1 day has passed, it's no longer worth it.
h.❌ \"Não esquece de avaliar a gente, hein: ❌ "Don't forget to review us, okay!" — sounds like a demand.
h.❌ \"Por favor avalia, ajuda muito a gent: ❌ "Please review us, it helps us a lot!" — sounds like begging.
h.✅ \"Se ficou bom pra você, levaria 30 se: ✅ "If you were happy with it, it would take 30 seconds to leave a review. It helps us so much." — sounds like an invitation.
h.\"Se ficou bom pra você\" — dá pro clien: "If you were happy with it" — gives the customer a choice (even if they always choose yes). Takes the pressure off.
h.\"Levaria 30 segundos\" — quantifica que: "It would take 30 seconds" — shows in numbers that it's quick. Removes the mental friction of "this will be a hassle".
h.\"Ajuda demais a gente\" — humaniza. O c: "It helps us so much" — makes it human. The customer is helping a person/team, not filling out a form.
h.Você: \"Foi um prazer, [Nome]! Antes de: You: "It was a pleasure, [Name]! Before you go, can I ask a 30-second favor? If you were happy with it, it would help us so much if you left a quick review on Google. Can I show you here?"
h.O segredo: você guia o cliente até o for: The secret: you guide the customer to the form. Don't leave it to them to "remember to do it later". Make the most of the 10 seconds they have right there in front of you.
h.Pra alto volume (cafés, restaurantes, lo: For high volume (cafés, restaurants, shops), asking out loud doesn't scale. The solution is an NFC or QR stand visible on the counter or table with a short line:
h.Texto na placa \"Curtiu? Aproxime o celu: Text on the stand "Enjoyed it? Tap your phone or scan the QR to review us on Google in 30 seconds. It really helps our small team. ✨"
h.Funciona pra prestadores de serviço (clí: Works for service providers (clinics, salons, technicians) who have the customer's contact. Send it within 1 hour at most. Any later and the chance drops by half.
h.Se foi assim, levaria 30 segundos pra de: If so, would you take 30 seconds to leave a quick review on Google? For a small business like ours, every review makes a huge difference.
h.Nome próprio assinando — humano, não emp: Sign with your own name — a human, not a company.
A light emoji — makes it human, but just 1 or 2.
h.Link direto pro formulário de review (nã: Direct link to the review form (not the Google profile — the profile requires extra steps). How to cut that friction to almost zero.
h.Nunca mande mais que 1 mensagem. Pediu,: Never send more than 1 message. You asked, they didn't reply, that's it. Chasing breeds resentment.
h.Pedir verbalmente converte ~15-25% dos c: Asking out loud converts ~15-25% of happy customers. Asking out loud + handing them the ready-made path on the spot (NFC, QR or direct link) reaches 50-70%.
h.A maior alavanca não é o roteiro perfeit: The biggest lever isn't the perfect script — it's eliminating the friction between the request and the form. That's why NFC stands and QR Codes have become standard in local businesses that grow their reviews steadily: the customer already has their phone in hand, taps, reviews. There's no "I'll do it later".
